pairs: I went up again to Jerusalem,
taking with me Barnabas and Titus.
And I went up according to revelation,
and I debated with them about the Gospel that I am preaching among the Gentiles,
but away from those who were pretending to be something,
seorsum autem iis qui videbantur aliquid esse:
was not compelled to be circumcised,
but only because of false brothers, who were brought in unknowingly.
They entered secretly to spy on our liberty,
which we have in Christ Jesus,
so that they might reduce us to servitude.
We did not yield to them in subjection,
ut veritas Evangelii permaneat apud vos:
in order that the truth of the Gospel would remain with you,
ab iis autem, qui videbantur esse aliquid (quales aliquando fuerint,
and away from those who were pretending to be something. (Whatever they might have been once,
God does not accept the reputation of a man.)
mihi enim qui videbantur esse aliquid, nihil contulerunt.
And those who were claiming to be something had nothing to offer me.
Sed e contra cum vidissent quod creditum est mihi Evangelium præputii,
But it was to the contrary,
since they had seen that the Gospel to the uncircumcised was entrusted to me,
just as the Gospel to the circumcised was entrusted to Peter.
(qui enim operatus est Petro in apostolatum circumcisionis,
For he who was working the Apostleship to the circumcised in Peter,
operatus est et mihi inter gentes):
was also working in me among the Gentiles.
when they had acknowledged the grace that was given to me,
and to Barnabas the right hand of fellowship,
so that we would go to the Gentiles,
while they went to the circumcised,
asking only that we should be mindful of the poor,
quod etiam sollicitus fui hoc ipsum facere.
which was the very thing that I also was solicitous to do.
But when Cephas had arrived at Antioch,
I stood against him to his face,
Prius enim quam venirent quidam a Jacobo,
For before certain ones arrived from James,
timens eos qui ex circumcisione erant.
fearing those who were of the circumcision.
Et simulationi ejus consenserunt ceteri Judæi,
And the other Jews consented to his pretense,
ita ut et Barnabas duceretur ab eis in illam simulationem.
so that even Barnabas was led by them into that falseness.
Sed cum vidissem quod non recte ambularent ad veritatem Evangelii,
But when I had seen that they were not walking correctly,
by the truth of the Gospel,
I said to Cephas in front of everyone:
are living like the Gentiles and not the Jews,
how is it that you compel the Gentiles to keep the customs of the Jews?”
and not of the Gentiles, sinners.
Scientes autem quod non justificatur homo ex operibus legis,
And we know that man is not justified by the works of the law,
but only by the faith of Jesus Christ.
et nos in Christo Jesu credimus,
And so we believe in Christ Jesus,
in order that we may be justified by the faith of Christ,
and not by the works of the law.
propter quod ex operibus legis non justificabitur omnis caro.
For no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
Quod si quærentes justificari in Christo,
while seeking to be justified in Christ,
we ourselves are also found to be sinners,
would then Christ be the minister of sin?
Si enim quæ destruxi, iterum hæc ædifico:
For if I rebuild the things that I have destroyed,
I establish myself as a prevaricator.
I have become dead to the law,
so that I may live for God.
I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
but truly Christ, who lives in me.
Quod autem nunc vivo in carne:
And though I live now in the flesh,
in fide vivo Filii Dei, qui dilexit me,
I live in the faith of the Son of God,
who loved me and who delivered himself for me.
I do not reject the grace of God.
